name: ASM-024 rack-and-pinion slide assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a small rack-and-pinion linear slide with rail base, carriage, rack teeth, pinion drive, rollers, and end stops.

tasks.prompt: Create a small rack-and-pinion slide assembly with a rail base, moving carriage, repeated slide rollers, a linear rack bar with repeated rack teeth, a pinion gear and drive shaft, and end stops. Favor reliable primitives and a meaningful assembly hierarchy.
assumptions: The rack teeth are repeated functional occurrences to exercise repeated component handling without fragile gear booleans.
The pinion is an approximate toothed compound that visually communicates a gear but avoids high-detail involute geometry.
Generated STEP, GLB, and topology artifacts are benchmark outputs, not source files.
